name: platform_wsl_adapters

test_list.description: Decode WSL UTF-16LE output and reject malformed code units.
Parse default marker, state, and WSL generation into typed rows.
Validate known .wslconfig keys, memory units, booleans, and duplicates.
Map Windows drive paths to /mnt and Linux paths to distro UNC paths.
Keep doctor output serializable and provisioning side-effect-free until explicitly confirmed.
Cancel an in-flight WSL call and verify the Linux descendant is gone without detached output readers.
Drop a retained keepalive and verify its Linux process group no longer exists.
Timeout a command with a child process and verify the Linux descendant PID is gone.
Reject output beyond the per-stream cap while preserving byte-exact output for a successful small command.

inputs.name: wsl_output
inputs.description: Raw output bytes emitted by wsl.exe.

output_description: A decoded typed report or a descriptive WSL adapter error.
